title: Aurelio Diaz
summary: A Division Agent in Broken Dawn whose investigation joins April Kelleher's Midwest antiviral trail and the novel's Washington intelligence handoff.

claims.text: Broken Dawn's published premise identifies Aurelio Diaz as one of the Division Agents traveling with April Kelleher's antiviral investigation.
In the novel's source-specific plot, Aurelio helps protect the Ann Arbor research lead while pursuing the operation coordinated through the Mantis codename.

paragraphs.text: Aurelio is one of Broken Dawn's named SHD Agents. The official premise places him beside April Kelleher as the inquiry moves out of the original game's New York setting.

The licensed novel makes Aurelio part of the source-specific effort to safeguard the research lead and counter the operation tied to Mantis. That connection does not identify Mantis's organization beyond what the novel establishes.

verification.notes: Licensed-novel record. The archive publishes no dialogue or scene transcript.
